digest.component_or_area: LLM sub-call model-class resolution across review gates
propositions: Four hand-built LLM sub-calls pass config=cfg without declaring a model class, so they inherit cfg.model and bypass the model-class configuration.
When model classes are set to Bedrock but cfg.model is left on direct Anthropic, these four sites resolve to direct Anthropic, sending real content off the configured provider.
overlap-judge dominates plan-review traffic at 18 of 23 calls, so a class-only cutover leaves the majority of plan-review traffic on direct Anthropic.
ticket-digest runs on the ticket store write path via enrich_drain.maybe_drain during ordinary comment/create operations, bypassing config with no gate or verdict to reveal it.
A regression test must pin the class-only configuration and construct the BM25F candidate condition deliberately, and must catch the general defect rather than enumerating the four sites by name.
Each site should select standard class per the operator design rule, resolving the score_code_novelty vs _score_floor_novelty parity question, while preserving fail-safe advisory behavior.
